title: 保護ケージ付き保守はしご
description: 壁面取付金具、横桟、保護フープと縦帯を備える垂直保守はしご。規格適合は未検証。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。
descriptionEn: A vertical maintenance ladder with wall brackets, rungs, protective hoops and cage straps. Safety-standard compliance has not been validated. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
